setup:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
runtime=/opt/koel-php
mkdir -p "$runtime/build/lists/partial" "$runtime/build/archives/partial"
apt_options=(-o "Dir::State::lists=$runtime/build/lists" -o Dir::State::status=/dev/null -o "Dir::Cache::archives=$runtime/build/archives" -o APT::Sandbox::User=root)
apt-get "${apt_options[@]}" update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get "${apt_options[@]}" install -y --download-only --no-install-recommends php8.5-cli php8.5-common php8.5-curl php8.5-mbstring php8.5-xml php8.5-intl php8.5-xsl php8.5-gd php8.5-sqlite3 php8.5-mysql php8.5-zip php8.5-bcmath
for package in "$runtime"/build/archives/*.deb; do dpkg-deb --extract "$package" "$runtime"; done
rm -rf "$runtime/build"'
warmup: python3 -c 'import json, subprocess; [subprocess.run(command, shell=True, executable="/bin/bash", check=True) for command in json.load(open(".homemade/config.json"))["install"]]'
install:
mkdir -p storage/app/homemade && printf %s '#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
runtime=/opt/koel-php
extension_dir=$(dirname "$(find "$runtime/usr/lib/php" -name intl.so -print -quit)")
options=(-n -d "extension_dir=$extension_dir" -d memory_limit=512M -d display_errors=0 -d log_errors=1)
if [[ -n "${APP_KEY:-}" && "$APP_KEY" != base64:* && ${#APP_KEY} -ne 32 ]]; then
  APP_KEY=$(printf '"'"'%s'"'"' "$APP_KEY" | sha256sum | cut -c 1-32)
  export APP_KEY
fi
for extension in pdo mysqlnd bcmath calendar ctype curl dom mbstring exif fileinfo ftp gd gettext iconv intl mysqli pdo_mysql pdo_sqlite phar posix shmop simplexml sockets sqlite3 sysvmsg sysvsem sysvshm tokenizer xml xmlreader xmlwriter xsl zip; do
  if [[ -f "$extension_dir/$extension.so" ]]; then options+=(-d "extension=$extension"); fi
done
exec "$runtime/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" --library-path "$runtime/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu" "$runtime/usr/bin/php8.5" "${options[@]}" "$@"
' > storage/app/homemade/php.sh && printf %s 'import { defineConfig, mergeConfig } from "vite-plus"
import config from "../../../vite.config"
const publicUrl = new URL(process.env.VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL!)
export default mergeConfig(config, defineConfig({ server: { host: "0.0.0.0", origin: publicUrl.origin, allowedHosts: [publicUrl.hostname], cors: { origin: process.env.APP_URL }, hmr: { protocol: "wss", host: publicUrl.hostname, clientPort: 443 } } }))
' > storage/app/homemade/vite.config.ts

composer --version && bash storage/app/homemade/php.sh "$(find "$HOME/.local/share/homemade/tools/composer" -name composer.phar -print -quit)" install --no-interaction --no-scripts && bash storage/app/homemade/php.sh artisan package:discover --no-interaction

app.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5173/@vite/client >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && exec bash storage/app/homemade/php.sh -S "0.0.0.0:$PORT" -t public server.php

web.cmd: exec npx --yes corepack pnpm exec vp dev --config storage/app/homemade/vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --strictPort
